data.summary: Steuerberatung Beispielmann & Partner mbB billed their client Ruben Beispielgaard €735.42 (invoice no. 2025/0712, dated 26 May 2025) for preparing the 2024 income tax return, including the Anlage V rental schedule for two properties, payable within 14 days of the invoice date.
data.explanation: This is a fee invoice from your tax advisor (Steuerberater) for preparing your 2024 income tax return and the rental income schedule (Anlage V). You need to transfer the total amount to the advisor's account by the deadline shown, which is counted from the invoice date. There is no legal remedy procedure attached to this document since it is a private invoice, not a decision by an authority. Tax advisor fees connected to rental income can often be deducted as income-related expenses (Werbungskosten) in your tax return, so keep this invoice for your records; ask your tax advisor if unsure.
